name: Alabama
note: Never conformed

name: Alaska
note: No state income tax

name: California
note: Never conformed. Largest U.S. startup cluster despite no QSBS. Combined top rate is 14.3% including the 1% Mental Health Services Tax on income over $1M (not modeled).

name: District of Columbia
note: Decoupled Dec 2025 via B26-0457 / Act 26-214 (Income and Franchise Tax Conformity). B25-0900 does not address §1202.

name: Florida
note: No state income tax. Top migration destination.

name: Hawaii
note: 50% exclusion only. Act 35 (May 26, 2026) freezes §1202 as of Dec 31, 2024 — no OBBBA $15M / 3-year / $75M pickup.

name: Illinois
note: SB 3019 signed June 16, 2026. Full §1202 add-back for tax years ending on/after Dec 31, 2026.

name: Maine
note: LD 2212 / ch. 650 (signed Apr 10, 2026): decoupled only for stock acquired after July 3, 2025. Pre-OBBBA stock still conforms.

name: Maryland
note: HB 801 decoupling bill failed in the 2026 session (adjourned April 13).

name: Massachusetts
note: Follows IRC as of Jan 1, 2024 (pre-OBBBA). Long-term CG taxed at 5%; 4% surtax above ~$1.11M not modeled. Separate 3% rate applies only to qualifying MA-domiciled stock.

name: Mississippi
note: Never conformed

name: Missouri
note: Exempts capital gains income

name: Nevada
note: No state income tax

name: New Hampshire
note: No state income tax on wages/cap gains

name: New Jersey
note: Full conformity in force for tax years beginning 2026+ (P.L. 2025 c.67).

name: New York
note: FY2027 budget (signed May 28, 2026) considered and rejected QSBS decoupling. Exclusion preserved.

name: Oregon
note: SB 1507 signed April 9, 2026. Full §1202 add-back for tax years beginning 2026+. Referendum failed to qualify. Gov. Kotek pledged 2027 QSBS legislation.

name: Pennsylvania
note: Never conformed

name: Rhode Island
note: HB 7127 Sub A: permanent §1202 add-back for tax years beginning on/after Jan 1, 2027. Still conforms for 2026 sales.

name: South Dakota
note: No state income tax

name: Tennessee
note: No state income tax

name: Texas
note: No state income tax. Top migration destination.

name: Vermont
note: Act 164 §55a add-back of the federal QSBS exclusion for 2026+. 40% capital-gains exclusion (cap $350k) still generally available.

name: Washington
note: 7% capital-gains excise tax (threshold ~$270k, indexed) still excludes QSBS. SB 6229 and HB 2292 failed in 2026.

name: Wyoming
note: No state income tax
